articles.summary: NEW YORK, April 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SLR Investment Corp. (the “Company”) (NASDAQ: SLRC) today announced that it will release its financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026 on Tuesday, May 5, 2026 after the close of the financial markets.
articles.title: SLR Investment Corp. Schedules the Release of its Financial Results for the Quarter Ended March 31, 2026
